organization: Cornell LII (reproducing Illinois Administrative Code, ICC rule)
title: 83 Ill. Adm. Code 454.30 Applicability (re-fetched Stage E)
claim: Part 454 applies to each ABC that sells/attempts to sell on behalf of a RES or procures/attempts to procure on behalf of a retail customer; it does not apply to (b)(3) a person acting exclusively for a single RES if exclusivity is disclosed, or (b)(5) any person who attempts to procure retail electric service on behalf of, or sell it to, a third party with aggregate billing demand of all affiliated Illinois accounts greater than 1,500 kW; also IPA, a RES selling on its own behalf, municipal power agency representatives, and public-body distribution owners. Source note: amended at 35 Ill. Reg. 17602, effective November 1, 2011.
excerpt: a third party that has an aggregate billing demand of all of its affiliated electric service accounts in Illinois of greater than 1,500 kW
limitations: LII copy updated quarterly, not the official JCAR text (ilga.gov unreachable: HTTP 503 / TLS failure on 2026-11-28). Exemption is customer-by-customer, not firm-wide.

organization: Cornell LII (reproducing Illinois Administrative Code, ICC rule)
title: 83 Ill. Adm. Code 454.20 Definitions (re-fetched Stage E)
claim: 'Aggregate billing demand' = total of the highest monthly billed demand of each of the retail customer's affiliated electric accounts during the past calendar year. 'Attempts to procure' includes preparing solicitations, notifying bidders, determining results; 'attempts to sell' includes soliciting customers, making offers or preparing contracts; both exclude professional services incidental to the sale/procurement (legal, accounting, engineering). 'Procure' = purchasing or contracting to purchase the services of a RES on behalf of a retail customer. 'Retail customer' as in 220 ILCS 5/16-102.
excerpt: the total of the highest monthly billed demand of each of the retail customer's affiliated electric accounts during the past calendar year
limitations: 'Affiliated' is not defined in Part 454; LII copy.

organization: ENGIE Resources
title: Payment Remittance Agreement (broker agreement template) V.10.2025
claim: Broker fee is a fee the customer agrees to pay the broker, embedded in price and remitted by ENGIE in monthly installments on the 25th of each month per a confirmation letter; withheld if the customer does not pay; subject to consumption true-up; payment obligation ends if the customer agreement terminates (default, change in law); post-term payment at ENGIE's discretion; ENGIE may contact customers directly and choose between competing brokers; broker warrants it holds all necessary licences and must disclose that its fee is included in the electricity price and share all bids truthfully; Texas law; fees confidential except to the customer.
